description: Range trader wallet sync — auto-detect manually deposited tokens and register them as active positions with S/R-based stop/target.

stories.title: Create range_wallet_sync.py
stories.description:
Create businesses/horizen-zkverify/range-trader/scripts/range_wallet_sync.py.

This script detects tokens that are present in the wallet but have no open position in range_positions.json, and auto-registers them as active positions.

The token list and addresses are defined in range_scanner.py:
```
TOKENS = {
    'ZEN':   '0xf43eb8de897fbc7f2502483b2bef7bb9ea179229',
    'VFY':   '0xa749de6c28262b7ffbc5de27dc845dd7ecd2b358',
    'ZRO':   '0x6985884c4392d348587b19cb9eaaf157f13271cd',
    'WETH':  '0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000006',
    'AAVE':  '0x63706e401c06ac8513145b7687a14804d17f814b',
    'CRV':   '0x8ee73c484a26e0a5df2ee2a4960b789967dd0415',
    'EIGEN': '0x2081ab0d9ec9e4303234ab26d86b20b3367946ee',
    'ETHFI': '0x6c240dda6b5c336df09a4d011139beaaa1ea2aa2',
    'W':     '0xb0ffa8000886e57f86dd5264b9582b2ad87b2b91'
}
```

Use these environment variables (load from .env if not set):
- BASE_RPC_URL (default: https://mainnet.base.org)
- METAMASK_WALLET_ADDRESS

Logic:

```python
ERC20_ABI = [{"inputs":[{"name":"account","type":"address"}],"name":"balanceOf",
              "outputs":[{"name":"","type":"uint256"}],"stateMutability":"view","type":"function"},
             {"inputs":[],"name":"decimals",
              "outputs":[{"name":"","type":"uint8"}],"stateMutability":"view","type":"function"}]

DUST_ETH = 0.0001  # ignore balances worth less than this in ETH

def sync_wallet_to_positions():
    """Check on-chain balances for all tracked tokens.
    For any token with balance > dust and no open position: auto-register.
    For any open position where on-chain balance changed: update token_balance.
    Returns list of new positions registered (for logging)."""
```

For each token in TOKENS:
1. Fetch on-chain balance via ERC-20 balanceOf (use decimals() to get decimals)
2. Load current positions from range_positions.load_positions()
3. Find existing open position for this symbol if any
4. If on-chain balance > dust AND no open position:
   - Call range_scanner.scan_one(symbol, address) to get S/R and price_eth
   - If S/R data available: set entry_price=price_eth, stop_loss=sr['support']*0.995, exit_price=sr['resistance']*0.995
   - If no S/R: set entry_price=price_eth, stop_loss=price_eth*0.90, exit_price=price_eth*1.20
   - Call range_positions.add_position() with full position dict including source='manual_deposit'
   - Send Telegram notification: f'[WALLET SYNC] Registered {symbol}: {bal:.4f} tokens @ E:{price_eth:.6f}'
5. If open position exists AND on-chain balance differs by >1% from recorded token_balance:
   - Update the position's token_balance to match on-chain balance
   - Save via range_positions.save_positions()
   - Print log line: f'[WALLET SYNC] Updated {symbol} balance: {old:.4f} -> {new:.4f}'

For Telegram notification, use:
```python
import requests, os
def notify(msg):
    token = os.environ.get('TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN', '')
    chat_id = os.environ.get('TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID', '')
    if token and chat_id:
        requests.post(f'https://api.telegram.org/bot{token}/sendMessage',
                      json={'chat_id': chat_id, 'text': msg}, timeout=10)
```

stories.title: Integrate wallet sync into pipeline
stories.description:
Edit businesses/horizen-zkverify/range-trader/scripts/run_range_pipeline.py to call wallet sync at pipeline start.

At the top of the main() function, BEFORE the scan_all() call, add:

```python
from range_wallet_sync import sync_wallet_to_positions
# Wallet sync: register manually deposited tokens
print('[PIPELINE] Wallet sync...')
try:
    new_positions = sync_wallet_to_positions()
    if new_positions:
        print(f'[PIPELINE] Wallet sync registered {len(new_positions)} new position(s)')
except Exception as e:
    print(f'[PIPELINE] Wallet sync error: {e}')
    errors.append(f'wallet_sync: {e}')
```

WS-002 acceptance criteria:
- python3 -m py_compile businesses/horizen-zkverify/range-trader/scripts/run_range_pipeline.py
- grep -n 'sync_wallet_to_positions' businesses/horizen-zkverify/range-trader/scripts/run_range_pipeline.py
